skills.detail:
Normal State:
 Moves towards enemies at long range and attacks multiple times with a Knockback effect.
 Inflicts an ATK debuff.

When Skill Power is boosted by 100%:
 Moves towards enemies at longer range and attacks multiple times with a Knockback effect.
 Inflicts an ATK debuff.
 
 Deals increased damage to Runners.
 Damage dealt will disregard the enemy DEF stat.
 Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.

 Skill 2 turns back into "I'll Just Have to Make Do!!!" after a set period of time passes.
